# FlatPurse Flow

> Booking, payments and AI recovery for salons, barbershops, spas, massage clinics and studios in Canada. Built in Edmonton, Alberta by FlatPurse Inc.

FlatPurse Flow is booking and client management software with an AI Front Desk, no-show recovery and Tap to Pay on iPhone (credit and Interac). It handles online booking, payments, client CRM, staff scheduling and sales tax for all 13 Canadian provinces and territories. Prices are in CAD and client data is stored in Canada.

## Plans (CAD per month, per location, before tax)

- Starter, C$39: up to 2 team members. Bookings, online booking page, clients, payments and Tap to Pay, reminders, reviews.
- Pro, C$89: up to 6 team members. Adds AI Front Desk, Daily Brief and client segments.
- Pro+, C$189: unlimited team members at one location. Adds AutoPilot (No-Show Recovery about an hour after a missed appointment, Last-Minute Slot Filler, win-backs, birthday offers), Flow Coach, Business Health Score and revenue forecasting.
- Enterprise: custom, 3+ locations.
- Founders Beta: 40% off year 1, then 25% off for life.
- Every plan starts with a free 14-day trial of Pro+, no card required.

## Payments

- Card payments are Stripe's standard Canadian rates, paid by the shop's own Stripe account and the same on every plan: 2.7% + 20 cents tapped credit, 30 cents flat for Interac, 2.9% + 30 cents online.
- No commission on new clients on any plan.
